description: This file defines the GDPR controller class for customer-related GDPR actions within the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for listing, approving, denying, and deleting GDPR data for customers, as well as handling filters, pagination, and permissions checks.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class managing customer GDPR actions such as listing GDPR requests, approval, denial, and removal.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for GDPR management page, initializes language, breadcrumb, and loads view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of GDPR requests with filtering, pagination, and rendering the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches the list of GDPR requests based on filters, applies pagination, and prepares data for the list view.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Processes GDPR approval actions, changing GDPR status to approved, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Processes GDPR denial actions, changing GDPR status accordingly, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles delete actions for GDPR requests, updating status or removing data, returning JSON response.
